name: kit-todos
description: Your open to-do tasks for the current project in a band above the prompt, with one-press buttons to hand a task to Claude, plus a pane, a /todo command and the project's latest memories.

todosFile.title: Todos file
todosFile.description: Path of the JSON file that holds your tasks. ~ means your home folder; a relative path is taken from your home folder. A missing file is an empty list, and /todo add creates it.

soonDays.title: Due-soon window (days)
soonDays.description: A task due within this many days counts as "Due soon". Whole number from 0 to 30; a value outside that range is cut to it.

showBand.title: Show the band above the prompt
showBand.description: Turn off to hide the band. The /todo command, the pane and the count in the status line keep working.

showMemories.title: Show the project's latest memories
showMemories.description: Show the newest memory of the current project in the band and the latest ones in the pane.

memoriesAllProfiles.title: Look for memories in every account profile
memoriesAllProfiles.description: Off: only the current profile's memories (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude). On: also ~/.claude and every ~/.claude-* profile, newest wins, so another account's memories can show in this session.
